blind.B1: Yes. Exercise arm = voluntary wheel running in TRAMP mice, prostate tumor RNA-seq (S4.3.p1, S4.6.p1). GSE293221 holds 9 sequenced samples: Exercise rep1-3 (GSM8878839-41) carry the exercise factor; Control rep1-3 and Nexrutine rep1-3 are the control and the PhAm diet arm (DA.p1, packet A grp). In-vivo, not in-vitro.
blind.B2: Exercise vs control and PhAm vs control, n = 3 tumors per group (S2.2.p1, S4.6.p1); 32 DEGs for exercise, 176 (100 down, 76 up) for PhAm (S2.2.p1, S2.2.p2).
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one tumor per animal, 3 of the 6 animals per arm sequenced (S4.6.p1). The only candidate key in packet A, 'suffix of title', is the replicate number rep1-3 within each arm, not an animal ID; the expression check does not support it (same-key r -0.011 vs other 0.003, permutation p 0.63).
blind.B4: S4.7.p1: 'DESeq was used to normalize data and find group-pairwise differential gene expression'. The paper does not say whether dispersion was estimated jointly on all groups or per pair.
blind.B5: S4.7.p1: at least one sample type has average RPKM > 1, FDR adjusted p < 0.05 and fold change > 1.5 (either way). Abstract writes >= 1.5-fold, adjusted p < 0.05. Counts: exercise vs control 32 DEGs; PhAm vs control 176 (100 down, 76 up); 2 genes overlap (S2.2.p3).

checks.evidence: B1: exercise arm (wheel running) present, 3 vs 3 vs 3; analysis ran (suitability analyzable).
grp from title matches characteristics treatment 3/3/3 and S4.6.p1 (3 per group); no exclusions; control = untreated control for both contrasts (S2.2.p1, S2.2.p2).
EX vs CON and PHAM vs CON with CON as reference; paper-named genes Lipe, Plin1, Slc7a10 down and Dgat2l6 up in EX agree in sign; the BB123696/Lman1l sign contradiction is recorded in study caveats.
B3: no repeated measures; 'suffix of title' is rep number, expression check not_supported (p 0.63); record states one tumor per animal, no blocking.

Paper says group-pairwise, silent on dispersion sharing (S4.7.p1). Both the joint (primary) and two-arm fits are reported; they differ strongly (EX vs CON 32 vs 385 DEGs). Choice of primary is an open policy question (human_items).
Exercise singly housed vs group-housed control and PhAm (S4.2.p1, S4.3.p1) is recorded as aliased with arm in covariance and study caveats.
Integer HTSeq counts (integer_fraction 1.0) match the paper's input; DESeq2 in place of original DESeq is a declared deviation; p-value fractions plausible (EX joint frac_p>0.9 0.166).

Transcribed as padj < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 0.5849625 (S4.7.p1 methods wording, not the abstract's >=); RPKM>1 prefilter not applicable without gene lengths and recorded with a CPM sensitivity run. Rule reproduces 32 for EX joint.
Same contrasts compared; HANDBACK calls the 32 = 32 match a coincidence and reports PHAM 3694 vs 176 and the two-arm 385 openly.

human_items: Primary fit choice: the joint ~grp model gives 32 EX DEGs (count equals the paper's, but Lipe/Plin1/Slc7a10 get padj NA because the heterogeneous PHAM arm drives Cook flags), while the two-arm CON+EX fit recovers all five paper-named exercise genes but calls 385 DEGs. The paper is silent on joint vs pairwise dispersion, so which to label primary is the open policy question.
PHAM vs CON gives 3694 DEGs vs the paper's 176 because two of three PHAM tumors are transcriptionally distinct; whether to treat this as a sample or tissue-content issue is for a person.
summary: 该案例通过复核：运动臂存在，3/3/3 分组与论文一致，无重复测量（title 后缀只是重复编号，表达检验不支持配对），阈值按论文 S4.7.p1 方法部分原样转录，运球笼养混杂已记录。唯一开放问题是联合模型与两臂模型哪个作为主结果（论文未说明），已列入 human_items。
